observed_failure: download_dukascopy.js requested getHistoricalRates format=json, then required Array.isArray(data). The Dukascopy Node API distinguishes array and JSON output formats; the official Node examples use the default array return. A nonempty JSON string was therefore eligible to be misclassified as no rows.
